name: beam_load
description: Simply supported (with optional overhangs) and cantilever beams under point loads, uniform and linearly varying distributed loads: reactions, shear and bending moment at given points, their extremes, and with E and I the slope and deflection and the maximum deflection, by exact integration of the elastic curve; single standard cases are cross-checked against the beam-table formulas. SI or imperial units. Not a structural design check.

support.description: cantilever: fixed at x = 0, free at x = L

supports.description: simply_supported: support positions [a, b], default [0, L]

magnitude.description: point: force; udl: force per length (downward positive)

position.description: point: x from the left end

I.description: Second moment of area (m^4 or in^4)

units.description: SI: N, m, N/m, Pa, m^4; imperial: lbf, in, lbf/in, psi, in^4

catalog.source: Euler-Bernoulli beam theory (EI y'' = M) integrated exactly; cross-checked against the beam diagrams and formulas of the AISC Steel Construction Manual, Table 3-23, and Roark's Formulas for Stress and Strain, Table 8.1
